title: Dispatch Note — Transport Lead-Time Surcharge on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Transport lead time.** For an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, the transport lead time is the number of calendar days from its signing date to the date of the handover appointment currently scheduled for it, as shown on the order's Delivery & Pickup Appointments record.

**Surcharge.**

| Transport lead time | Lead-time surcharge added to the transfer shipping fee |
|---|---|
| 3 days or fewer (the rush transport days) | $120.00 (the rush transport surcharge) |
| more than 3 days, up to 7 days (the expedited transport days) | $65.00 (the expedited transport surcharge) |
| more than 7 days | none |

The lead-time surcharge is added to the transfer shipping fee after the carrier price has been reduced by the program's shipping fee discount and rounded half up to the cent.

**Day counts (hypothetical, signing on day 0).**

| Appointment scheduled for | Lead time | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| day 3 | 3 | $120.00 |
| day 4 | 4 | $65.00 |
| day 7 | 7 | $65.00 |
| day 8 | 8 | none |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A discounted transfer price of $824.25 on an order whose appointment is scheduled five days after signing becomes $889.25. If the appointment is rescheduled to day 9, the lead time read from the newly scheduled date is 9 days and no lead-time surcharge applies.
